update_runtime_params: update runtime parameters based on edge model outputs for temperature and impurity boundary conditions
update_enrichment_factor: update enrichment factors from extended Lengyel edge model outputs for impurity concentration scaling
update_temperatures: update electron and ion temperature boundary conditions at the LCFS from edge model separatrix temperature
update_impurities: update impurity concentration profiles based on seeded or fixed impurity values from edge model outputs
calculate_impurity_scaling_factor: calculate scaling factor for impurity profiles using enrichment and current LCFS concentration values
